sections.heading: Overview of Alumni Association
sections.content:
Dr. Ramesh Shelar Secretary (Alumni), Alumni Association of APCOER 9689931242 RVS300668@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/ramesh-shelar-474140120
Warm greetings to all of you! Our Institute is having a dynamic learning environment, focusing on a stimulating student experience. Our students come from rural and mostly first generation graduate, seeking a space where they can learn from finest faculty to enrich their knowledge in challenging curriculum and modern methods in education. As Secretary, my primary responsibility is to establish a bond between the institute and alumni so that alumni will participate in the activities of college and use their expertise and skills for betterment of present students. I encourage you to stay connected with our association, attend our events, and take advantage of the resources we offer. Your involvement is crucial to the success of our association, and we are committed to ensuring that our alumni community remains strong and supportive.
